messages.content:
Root cause: `estimate_cost` multiplied token count by a *per-million* USD rate, so 1000 tokens at $0.15/M produced 150 instead of 0.00015.

Fix: divide by 1e6 (`(tokens_in / 1_000_000.0) * rate`) in `src/pricing.py`. First pytest run failed (reproduced); after the patch, `tests/test_pricing.py` is green (1 passed).
